title: Ryan: create the caducus-production AWS account and its access
description:
**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** Only Ryan can create an AWS account. Plan: docs/notifications-plan.md.

**Build.**
1. In AWS Organizations (management account) create an account named `caducus-production`, using a mailbox only Ryan controls.
2. In IAM Identity Center assign the AdministratorAccess permission set to it, and add a local profile `caducus-production` (region us-east-1).
3. For the alarm forwarder (kanbus-be0e9d): enable trusted access for CloudFormation StackSets in AWS Organizations and register `caducus-production` as a delegated administrator for StackSets.
4. Say the profile name in the session. The id goes in the GitHub repository variable `CADUCUS_AWS_ACCOUNT`, never in Git.

**Acceptance.**
`AWS_PROFILE=caducus-production aws sts get-caller-identity` works; `aws sesv2 get-account` answers (it will show the sandbox).
